meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能写 Python 代码用 benchling-sdk 或 REST API 操作 Benchling 账号:管理 DNA/RNA/蛋白质等注册实体、库存、ELN 条目、流程任务,查询数据仓库,支持事件集成,并处理认证/重试/分页。
howto.when: 当你要求用 Benchling Python SDK 或 v2 API 自动化实验室数据时触发,例如管理注册实体、操作库存、创建 ELN 条目等。

say.text: 创建一条名为 Test Plasmid 的环状 DNA,碱基 ATCGATCG
把容器 cont_abc123 转移到盒子 box_xyz789
say.note: 会调用 containers.transfer 完成转移。

say.text: 列出 Benchling 里所有 DNA 序列,输出名称和 ID
say.note: 会用分页生成器遍历并打印结果。

howto.what_en: Claude uses benchling-sdk or REST API to manage Benchling entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflow tasks, Data Warehouse, and events. It writes Python code handling auth, retries, pagination.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to automate lab data with Benchling's Python SDK or v2 API — e.g., managing registry entities, inventory operations, creating ELN entries, etc.

say_en.text: Create a circular DNA named Test Plasmid with bases ATCGATCG.
say_en.note: Claude generates Python code calling dna_sequences.create.

say_en.text: Transfer container cont_abc123 to box box_xyz789.
say_en.note: Calls containers.transfer to complete the move.

say_en.text: List all DNA sequences in Benchling and show their names and IDs.
say_en.note: Uses a paginated generator and prints results.
